The '''Royal Resident''' is an [[NPC]] located in the {{zone|Barracks of Heroes}}. They attempt to make the player leave the room, by having an incredibly long set of dialogue.

== Tips ==
*You can hold right click instead of continually clicking the NPC to keep the dialogue going.
** Once he starts counting down, there is no need to click or hold mouse buttons anymore.
** The countdown will continue when you rejoin the Dwarven mines.

== Trivia ==
*The '''Royal Resident''' is one of the few NPCs that break the [[w:Fourth wall|fourth wall]], a term used to describe a character separated from its audience, due to it being in a "different world".  
**This is because it is aware that it's on a server and that servers restart.
*Its countdown takes roughly 25,000 seconds, or around 7 hours to complete.
*Despite the reference to server restarts, the player can leave the lobby anytime after the Royal Resident starts counting down from 5,000 and will continue the countdown when the player returns.
*At line 79 it transforms into a cow, and at line 94 into a sheep, followed by revealing that he has no name at line 130.
*21 lines after becoming "No Name", it will give the player {{Item|The Cake}}.
*{{Item|The Cake}} is a reference to the game ''[https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Portal_(video_game)  Portal]''. 
**It takes around 15–20 minutes to obtain {{Item|The Cake}}.
*"Because of you and those meddling kids..." is a reference to a popular children's show, [[w:Scooby Doo|''Scooby Doo'']].
*At the end of the conversation, the {{ach|Royal Conversation|ach=true}} is rewarded to the player.
